summary:
Aethelia: The Intelligent Climate Engine

We developed Aethelia, an interactive web-based climate analytics platform designed to solve the Earth System Trend Detective challenge. Raw multi-year satellite records are often saturated with seasonal fluctuations and statistical noise, masking up to 70% of gradual climate shifts and hiding dangerous regional teleconnections—where opposing extremes like severe droughts and catastrophic floods occur simultaneously across linked basins.

Aethelia addresses this challenge by ingesting multi-decadal NASA telemetry from GRACE-FO, GPM, GLDAS, and OMI. Our automated analytical pipeline applies Seasonal-Trend decomposition using LOESS (STL) to strip away seasonal noise, followed by non-parametric Mann-Kendall statistical testing (

details:
1. How It Works

Aethelia is an interactive climate analytics lab that processes NASA satellite datasets (GRACE-FO, GPM, GLDAS, and OMI) through a three-step automated pipeline:

  • Data Harmonization: Spatially and temporally aligns groundwater, precipitation, soil moisture, and atmospheric records.
  • Noise Isolation (STL): Strips away seasonal fluctuations and random noise to extract the true underlying climate trend.
  • Statistical Verification (Mann-Kendall): Mathematically proves (p<0.05p < 0.05p<0.05) that observed climate shifts are genuine rather than random variability, uncovering linked opposing extremes (droughts and floods).

2. Benefits & Intended Impact

  • Eliminating Blind Spots: Detects drought and flood risks early, uncovering the 70% of shifts normally masked by raw data noise.
  • Accessible Science: Replaces complex geospatial coding with an intuitive visual dashboard understandable at a glance.
  • Serving 4 Billion People: Empowers scientists, water engineers, and policymakers to manage water resources proactively and mitigate disasters before they strike.

3. Tools & Technologies

  • Language & Interface: Python and Streamlit for the interactive web app.
  • Data & Statistics: statsmodels, pymannkendall, pandas, numpy, and xarray, paired with Plotly/Matplotlib for interactive charts.

4. Creativity & Design Considerations

  • Innovative Framing: Connects opposite climate disasters under the concept "One Climate Engine, Two Opposite Extremes" rather than analyzing them in isolation.
  • Statistical Integrity & Clarity: Uses non-parametric tests (Mann-Kendall and Sen’s Slope) to avoid false positives in non-normal climate data, presented in a high-contrast UI that separates noise from verified trends.
